name: D9b shared group amplitude confirmation
purpose: replace six redundant per-level zero decisions with one permutation-invariant response amplitude per nested probe group
scope: TRAIN-only same-example confirmation; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, deployment, or visual transfer

data.selection: identical eight groups used by D6-D9 audits

model.encoder: unchanged D9 raw temporal endpoint encoder and level context
model.factorization: predicted log-separation equals one shared ReLU group amplitude times a per-level softplus normalized shape
model.amplitude_pooling: mean of the six contextualized level features; invariant to level permutation
model.amplitude_target: RMS magnitude over all six levels and all 41 continuous log1p gap/curve values in a group
model.shape_target: each level target divided by the shared group amplitude for nonzero groups only
model.zero_handling: all shape losses omitted exactly when the continuous group target amplitude is zero

optimization.batching: deterministic full batch of all eight groups and six levels
optimization.loss: shared group amplitude MSE plus five equally weighted masked per-level shape MSE terms
optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step for every seed; no best-seed or intermediate selection

replication_decision: all three fixed final checkpoints must pass every per-seed gate

interpretation.all_pass: freeze D9b and authorize one episode-held-out TRAIN comparison against D2
interpretation.any_fail: stop modifying the predictor and investigate a boundary test that is robust to microscopic amplitude without a calibrated cutoff
